name: First Flight
description: Your dragon is ready to try its wings. Something in Mossy Hollow disagrees.

intro.speaker: dragon
intro.text: *flaps hard, lifts one inch, lands on your foot*

intro.speaker: rider
intro.text: Good start! Let's find a clearing with fewer roots.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Two Moss Wisps drift over to watch. Then they start pecking.

intro.speaker: rider
intro.text: One more try. Run, jump, flap!

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: An Elder Thornling is sleeping in the clearing. Was sleeping.

outro.speaker: narrator
outro.text: Your dragon takes off, circles the clearing twice, and only hits one tree.

name: Trial of Wings
description: To grow up, your dragon must fly to the top of Thunderspire. The locals have opinions.

intro.speaker: rider
intro.text: Up we go. Try not to look down.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A Gale Hawk is not impressed by your flying.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Halfway up, a Cliff Harpy starts singing. Your ears would like to leave.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The Thunderhead that lives up here wants a word. The word is lightning.

outro.speaker: narrator
outro.text: At the top of Thunderspire, your dragon roars. It's a real roar now, deep enough to rattle the clouds.

outro.speaker: rider
outro.text: Look at you. All grown up. Can I ride you now? Please?

outro.speaker: dragon
outro.text: *kneels down so you can climb on*
